name: Boxuchan: The Visual Novel ~ Prologue
source:
Have you ever wanted to start your own anime business? 

Well, our heroine Claire certainly has!

The popular anime store, Boxuchan has their mascots Claire and Elliot come to life for the first time in this prequel visual novel! Experience the lore of how Boxuchan started through both Claire and Elliot's prescriptive in a two hour visual novel experience!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3832560/]Steam[/url]]
